objects.label: Vine: BLOOM then E at handle
Falling stone: freeze near blue markers
Water: FREEZE then E at the leaf dock
Root: BLOOM to bridge and conduct
Root: BLOOM connects source to rotor
Spring core: PULSE only after power arrives

stages.title: Bloom: flower and vine
stages.hint: BLOOM the flower; stand on it and Space. BLOOM the vine; E near its handle; Space to release forward.

stages.title: Freeze: falling stone and slate
stages.hint: FREEZE the falling stone near the low blue mark; jump to the ledge. Freeze the slate near 0 degrees.

stages.title: Pulse + Freeze: machine bridge
stages.hint: PULSE the machine to rotate it. FREEZE near 0 degrees, then cross the cyan bridge.

stages.title: Pulse + Freeze: ice ski jump
stages.hint: PULSE the sluice, FREEZE the water, then E beside the leaf. Steer with A/D; launch at the ramp end.

stages.title: Bloom + Pulse: living conductor
stages.hint: BLOOM the root bridge. PULSE the source. Power must travel through the grown root to open the far door.

stages.title: The spring: three abilities together
stages.hint: BLOOM the roots, PULSE the source, FREEZE the powered rotor at 0 degrees. Cross and PULSE the central core.
